role: One post-open Case 19 frame-zero mechanism gate for a deployment-visible, nonlinear, local multiscale correction followed by one unchanged restarted PCGLS step. It is not a block-size continuation, a global low-rank tail model, a Sobolev or global-quadratic penalty, or a learned model.
scientific_question: Can a one-level 3D Haar universal-threshold correction remove the finite-view high-frequency component of the converged K13 field strongly enough to repair the common Case 19 frame-zero interior-gradient blocker, while preserving field and observation accuracy and using fewer exact calls than K16?
physical_hypothesis: The v248 exact voxel blocks greatly reduce observation residual while worsening all field-gradient metrics, whereas diagonal-Jacobi K14 and K16 are already numerically stationary at the single remaining frame-zero blocker. A nonlinear local multiscale shrinkage that estimates its scale only from the visible K13 field can suppress unsupported finest-scale oscillation without erasing the coarse plume structure. A final unchanged restarted PCGLS K1 restores measurement consistency.
design_evidence_boundary: The frequency-localization audit that motivated this protocol is post-open exploratory diagnosis and is not itself a scientific result. It selects no threshold multiplier, wavelet family, level count, depth, rig, camera subset or metric after v249 scores are observed.

frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_roster: For each rig use the first nine stable IDs in the v209 order, then sort IDs in ascending ASCII order before operator construction.
frozen_data_and_geometry.preprocessing: Reuse the exact v248 frame-zero full-grid parser, float64 trilinear interpolation, one-voxel support and interior-mean gauge.
frozen_data_and_geometry.truth_use: CFD truth generates the synthetic observation and scores four veto metrics only. It never enters K13, Haar coefficients, MAD scale, threshold, controls, restarted K1, depth or stopping.

unique_primary.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k13_haar_mad_soft_restart_pcgls_k1
unique_primary.transform: Apply one orthonormal Haar level in fixed z, then y, then x order. The approximation occupies the low half of every axis; the other seven 16x8x8 subbands are details.
unique_primary.threshold: tau = sigma * sqrt(2*log(7168)). Soft-threshold all seven detail subbands by sign(c)*max(abs(c)-tau,0); leave LLL unchanged.
unique_primary.support_and_gauge: Before the transform and after inverse transform, set the one-voxel boundary exactly to zero and subtract the active-cell mean.
unique_primary.refinement: Compute the exact projection of the corrected field, then run exactly one standard fixed-SPD reported-geometry diagonal-Jacobi PCGLS iteration from that initializer. No fallback or early stopping.

controls.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k13_haar_approximation_only_restart_pcgls_k1
controls.definition: Set all seven detail subbands to zero instead of MAD soft-thresholding, then use the identical support/gauge and restarted PCGLS K1 shell.

controls.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k16_reference
controls.definition: Frozen parent reference and same frame-zero blocker.

forbidden_search: No wavelet family, level, phase, threshold multiplier, scale estimator, subband subset, hard/soft rule, support, gauge, initializer, depth, preconditioner, camera subset, rig, metric or threshold search is allowed after freeze.

accuracy_gate.control_dominance: If either equal-or-cheaper correction/control also passes every frame-zero cell, Haar-MAD-specific headroom is not isolated.

independent_validation.method: A second program must rebuild observations and diagonal Jacobi, use explicit nested-loop Haar pair transforms and coefficient thresholding rather than the formal vectorized implementation, rerun all four arms, seal its arrays before reading formal scientific arrays, and recompute metrics, gates and costs.

decision_order: Any source, parent, shape, finite, Haar roundtrip, support, gauge, threshold, permutation, call-ledger, replay, seal or formal-independent mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_HAAR_MAD_WARM_FRAME_ZERO_V249.

If the unique Haar-MAD primary fails any of the 13 absolute frame-zero cells, conclude FAIL_CASE19_HAAR_MAD_WARM_FRAME_ZERO_V249 and close this fixed multiscale correction without a full 429-cell run.

If the primary passes all 13 but the approximation-only or cheaper K14 control also passes all 13, conclude PASS_CASE19_FRAME_ZERO_BUT_HAAR_MAD_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V249 and do not claim Haar-MAD headroom.

Only if the primary passes 13/13, the controls remain incomplete, every ledger and independent check passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_HAAR_MAD_FRAME_ZERO_HEADROOM_V249 and authorize a separately frozen full 429-cell causal-warm sequence gate.
failure_action: Close the fixed one-level Haar-MAD correction without changing wavelet, level, threshold rule or multiplier, scale estimator, subbands, phase, support, depth or controls. Do not use a neural model or GPU to rescue it.
